title: Relaunching a Fashion Brand Experience on Web
subtitle: Rebuilding a global fashion retailer's entrances — Start Page and Department navigation — to lift brand perception and move customers down the funnel.

intro.paragraph: Fashion Rebrand project focused on rebuilding a global fashion retailer's digital entrances to lift brand perception and improve customer journey through the funnel.

challenge: Brand read as retail, not fashion — dropping recognition, sales, and retention.

goals.goal: Lift brand perception through refined visual identity and user experience.
Improve customer journey and reduce bounce rates.
Increase session engagement and reduce exit rates.
